messages.subject: Suggestions for project proposal NicheToolBox
parts:
Hi everyone, 
My name is Luis Osorio I am working on the NicheToolBox project (https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2016/wiki/NicheToolbox)  which will be an R package for doing Species Distribution Modeling (SDM). The package will have GUI which will be developed using the Shiny framework. 
I'll be really happy if you can give any suggestions to the project proposal (https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B7JkSmwKz9TwWm1Qd0YxTG5zZm8) and as soon as I have the github repo I'll notify you. 
Hoping to have feedback from you
Best wishes 
Luis
